description: This Go source file defines a package 'artifacts' that manages download and organization of build artifacts for a Cuttlefish device environment. It contains a 'Manager' struct with methods to fetch different artifact bundles like CVD, kernel, and bootloader, utilizing download registries and concurrency controls. The file includes types for fetching options, registries for download caching, and utility functions for directory creation.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: Handles the fetching and organization of build artifacts like CVD bundles, kernels, and bootloaders for Cuttlefish device environments.

classes.name: registry
classes.description: Caching registry to manage concurrent artifact downloads, avoiding duplicated downloads.

classes.name: downloadContext
classes.description: Tracks the state of a download operation for a particular directory, ensuring the download runs only once.

classes.name: ExtraCVDOptions
classes.description: Optional parameters for fetching CVD bundles, including system image build ID and target.

methods.name: NewManager
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new artifact manager instance with specified root directory and UUID generator.

methods.name: GetCVDBundle
methods.description: Fetches a CVD bundle, supporting custom options and ensuring caching to prevent duplicate downloads.

methods.name: GetKernelBundle
methods.description: Retrieves kernel artifacts, fetching 'bzImage' and optionally 'initramfs.img'. Uses caching and concurrency control.

methods.name: GetBootloaderBundle
methods.description: Fetches bootloader artifacts like 'u-boot.rom' with caching and concurrency controls.

methods.name: GetOrDownload
methods.description: Checks if the directory has been downloaded; if not, runs the download function exactly once with synchronization.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the download function on the downloadContext, ensuring it only runs once.
